up: Retrieve all exact IC50 values in nM for compounds tested against human PDE4B (target ChEMBL ID CHEMBL275). For each result, include the compound's ChEMBL ID and canonical SMILES, the activity's standard relation and value, the assay description, and the target's ChEMBL ID and preferred name. If available, also provide the PubMed ID or DOI for the document associated with the activity.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  a.standard_relation,
  a.standard_value,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL275'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM'
  AND a.standard_relation = '='
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;
